run_responses_tool_calling: run the example to perform a two-turn tool-calling conversation with a vLLM server via the OpenAI Responses API
create_openai_client_for_vllm: create an OpenAI client pointing to a local vLLM server at http://0.0.0.0:8000/v1
define_function_calling_tool: define a strict function-calling tool schema with required latitude and longitude parameters
execute_tool_call_and_retrieve_result: execute a model-generated function call by parsing arguments and invoking the get_weather mock function
send_tool_output_back_to_model: send the tool call result back to the model for a final natural language response
